0.05 -\u003e [-0.05, 0.05]\n    const double perturbation = ((seed % 10001) / 10000.0) * 0.1 - 0.05;\n\n    const double threshold_upper = 1.15 + perturbation;\n    const double threshold_lower = 0.85 + perturbation;\n\n    // Step 3: Forced Restart\n    // If local search quality is degrading (ratio \u003e 1.15), force immediate restart\n    // bypassing the standard conflict limit.\n    if (divergence_ratio \u003e threshold_upper) {\n        kissat_extremely_verbose(solver,\n            \"adaptive restart: ratio %.2f \u003e limit %.2f (fast %.2f, slow %.2f)\",\n            divergence_ratio, threshold_upper, fast, slow);\n        return true;\n    }\n\n    // Step 4: Restart Veto\n    // Only applies if we have hit the standard conflict limit\n    if (CONFLICTS \u003e= solver-\u003elimits.restart.conflicts) {\n        // If finding good clauses (ratio \u003c 0.85), extend the run\n        if (divergence_ratio \u003c threshold_lower) {\n            // Calculate standard interval (delta) as proxy for \"conflicts since last restart\"\n            uint64_t delta = GET_OPTION(restartint);\n            uint64_t restarts = GET(restarts);\n            if (restarts)\n                delta += kissat_logn(restarts) - 1;\n            \n            // Increment the limit effectively doubling the allowance for this period\n            solver-\u003elimits.restart.conflicts += delta;\n\n            kissat_extremely_verbose(solver,\n                \"adaptive veto: ratio %.2f \u003c limit %.2f, extending by %\" PRIu64,\n                divergence_ratio, threshold_lower, delta);\n            \n            return false;\n        }\n        // Limit reached and no veto -\u003e Restart\n        return true;\n    }\n\n    return false;\n}\n\u003c/code\u003e","thoughtSignature":""}],"role":"model"},"finishReason":"STOP","index":0}]},"model":"models/gemini-3-pro-preview"}
